subgoals.title: Goal Relayの新規計画を重複なく安全に受信する
acceptanceCriteria: Add a bounded, local-only one-shot receiver command using Node.js standard libraries that checks a fixed allowlisted GitHub plan path and stages only a newly validated plan, without invoking Codex or automatically importing goals.

Record the last accepted plan blob SHA in a workspace-local receipt ledger so duplicate polling is idempotent; reject changed or malformed schemas, unexpected paths and unreviewed RUNNING goals without altering goal-state-live.json.
Add focused tests for first receipt, duplicate receipt, invalid remote plan, failed fetch and pending human review, while preserving existing tests.
